investigation_notes.Playbook Used: Azure Network Security Group Modification Triage
investigation_notes.Description: A security rule deletion was performed against nsg-tallinn-prod-01 in the rg-baltic-prod-connectivity resource group by markus.tamm@globalcorp.ee from IP 145.14.39.114 and the operation succeeded. The activity occurred at 11:15 local time in Estonia and correlates with a recent similar alert (SOC-23101) for the same user and IP that was previously reviewed and documented as part of approved Change Request CR-2026-044. Given the matching actor, expected geolocation, timing during normal working hours, and the corroborating historical change record, the activity is assessed as routine administrative work and presents low priority risk.
